ClusterConfiguration.description: The cluster configuration of the resource at the time of backup.

DedicatedCompactor.description: Indicates if the compactor instance is a standalone instance or not.

IngestQueryInstances.description: The number of ingest and query instances in the cluster.

QueryOnlyInstances.description: The number of query-only instances in the cluster.

LogDeliveryConfiguration.description: The log delivery configuration of the resource at the time of backup.

MaintenanceSchedule.description: The maintenance schedule of the resource at the time of backup.

PreferredMaintenanceWindow.description: The preferred maintenance window in the format ddd:HH:MM-ddd:HH:MM.

Timezone.description: The IANA timezone identifier for the maintenance window.

S3Configuration.description: Configuration for S3 bucket log delivery.

BucketName.description: The name of the S3 bucket to deliver logs to.

Enabled.description: Indicates whether log delivery to the S3 bucket is enabled.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

description: Resource type definition for AWS::Timestream::InfluxDBBackup. An on-demand backup of an Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance or DB cluster.

AllocatedStorage.description: The allocated storage of the resource at the time of backup, in GiB.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the backup.

CreatedAt.description: The time when the backup was created.

DbInstanceType.description: The DB instance type of the resource at the time of backup.

DbParameterGroupId.description: The identifier of the DB parameter group associated with the backup.

DbResourceId.description: The id of the DB instance or DB cluster to back up.

DbStorageType.description: The storage type of the resource at the time of backup.

DeploymentType.description: The deployment type of the resource that the backup was created from.

EngineType.description: The engine type of the resource that the backup was created from.

ExpiresAfter.description: The date after which the backup will be automatically deleted, as a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

FailoverMode.description: The failover mode of the resource at the time of backup.

Id.description: Service-generated unique identifier of the backup.

InfluxAuthParametersSecretArn.description: The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing the InfluxDB auth parameters.

KmsKeyId.description: The Amazon Web Services KMS key ARN used for encryption of the resource at the time of backup.

Name.description: The name of the backup. Must be unique within the account and region.

NetworkType.description: The network type of the resource at the time of backup.

Port.description: The port number of the resource at the time of backup.

PubliclyAccessible.description: Indicates whether the resource was publicly accessible at the time of backup.

RetentionDays.description: The number of days to retain the backup. Valid values are 1 to 3650.

Status.description: The current status of the backup.

Tags.description: A list of key-value pairs to associate with the backup.

Type.description: The type of backup. Backups created through this resource type are always ON_DEMAND.

VpcSecurityGroupIds.description: The VPC security group IDs associated with the resource at the time of backup.

VpcSubnetIds.description: The VPC subnet IDs associated with the resource at the time of backup.
